items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: But Shooters Joe Jackson was a white player.

ctx.x: He's the one that's, you remember in 1990, when the White Sox had all that problem?
Right. But Shooters Joe Jackson was a white player.

Yeah, he was down there with the Pelicans. Well, yes, with the white Pelicans. The white Pelicans. Sure. So, but that other Jackson. Jumbo Jackson. There was another guy in town. So, they had a lot of teams coming in.
